$comment: Every label the workflows apply. Housekeeping creates and updates them from this file (it never deletes one). Renaming a label here creates a new one; rename it in the repository first.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something does not work, or works wrongly

labels.name: device
labels.description: A monitor for the device library

labels.name: needs-info
labels.description: Waiting for the author; closes after three weeks without a reply

labels.name: stale
labels.description: No activity for a while; closes unless someone replies

labels.name: first-contribution
labels.description: The author's first pull request here

labels.name: needs-maintainer
labels.description: Touches what only a maintainer may change; see the policy comment

labels.name: maintainer-approved
labels.description: A maintainer read the sensitive changes and lets the policy check pass

labels.name: area: engine
labels.description: The resident engine and the taskbar helper
